name: @speedora/editorial-director
description: Stateless module (JSON-in/JSON-out): Editorial Director Phase A ("Editorial Intelligence 2.0" - see docs/ai/editorial-director.md). A pure, synchronous composition (no LLM call) over already-computed clip-scoring/virality-engine/narrative-graph/semantic-events/visual-emphasis/conversation-intelligence/platform-fit outputs into one EditorialDecision - fixing clip-ranking's own documented double-counting bug by composing a smaller set of named editorial categories instead of averaging correlated raw sub-scores, plus negative-signal penalties, boundary nudging, and diversity-aware candidate selection. No DB/queue access at all; see root ARCHITECTURE.md. Consumed by apps/worker's candidate-shortlist and render-clip.worker.ts wiring.
